import datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, platform, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/Users/jasonqin/Documents/GitHub/NeoProlog')
work = Path('/private/tmp/infera-slots-2026-10-18')
before = work / 'baseline'
relative = 'dist-newstyle/build/aarch64-osx/ghc-9.8.2/infera-2.0.0/b/core-major/opt/build/core-major/core-major'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('external', root / 'bench/core_external.py')
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def runtime(directory):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for path in sorted((directory / 'src').rglob('*.hs')):
        digest.update(str(path.relative_to(directory)).encode() + b'\0' + path.read_bytes() + b'\0')
    return digest.hexdigest()

engines = {
    'before': (str(before / relative), before),
    'after': (str(root / relative), root),
    'swipl': ('/Applications/SWI-Prolog.app/Contents/MacOS/swipl', root),
    'scryer': ('/opt/homebrew/Cellar/scryer-prolog/0.10.0/bin/scryer-prolog', root),
}
identities = {name: {'binary': binary, 'binary_sha256': sha(binary)}
              for name, (binary, _) in engines.items()}
runtimes = {name: runtime(directory) for name, (_, directory) in engines.items() if name in ('before', 'after')}
assert runtimes['before'] == json.loads((work / 'baseline.json').read_text())['runtime_sha256']
assert sha(before / 'bench/core-major.hs') == sha(root / 'bench/core-major.hs')
sources = {str(path): sha(path) for path in [root / 'bench/core-major.hs', root / 'bench/bench.nprolog',
    root / 'bench/bench.pl', root / 'bench/core-external.pl', root / 'bench/core_external.py',
    root / 'examples/breadboard.nprolog', root / 'examples/minesweeper.nprolog']}
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
provenance = {'kind': 'provenance', 'revision': revision, 'candidate': 'uncommitted working tree',
    'runtimes': runtimes, 'binaries': identities, 'sources': sources,
    'compiler': 'GHC 9.8.2 -O2; nonprofiling', 'host': platform.platform(),
    'versions': {name: subprocess.check_output([engines[name][0], '--version'], text=True).strip()
                 for name in ('swipl', 'scryer')}, 'orchestrator_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
(work / 'measurement-provenance.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps(provenance, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
batches = {'core-nrev': 256, 'core-loop': 256, 'controls': 1024, 'guards': 64,
    'deep-index': 32, 'liveness': 8, 'table-cycle': 2048, 'table-cycle240': 128,
    'core-fib': 4, 'core-queens': 16, 'breadboard-rc': 128, 'breadboard-div': 64,
    'breadboard-tri': 32, 'breadboard-wide': 8, 'minefield-16': 4}
with (work / 'measurements.jsonl').open('w') as out:
    for round_ in range(6):
        for index, (case, batch) in enumerate(batches.items()):
            names = ['before', 'after', 'swipl', 'scryer'] if case in ('core-nrev', 'core-loop') else ['before', 'after']
            shift = (round_ + index) % len(names)
            names = names[shift:] + names[:shift]
            for position, name in enumerate(names):
                binary, directory = engines[name]
                command = ([binary, '--case', case, '--batch', str(batch), '--timeout', '60', '+RTS', '-T', '-RTS']
                    if name in ('before', 'after') else helper.command(name, binary, case, batch))
                started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
                process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=directory, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=190)
                assert process.returncode == 0, (name, case, process.stdout, process.stderr)
                if name in ('before', 'after'):
                    row = json.loads(process.stdout)
                    assert row['status'] == 'ok' and row['oracle_checked'] and row['independent_checked'], row
                    assert row['fully_drained'] and row['untimed_core_preflight_queries'] == 1, row
                    assert row['cpu_seconds'] >= .05, ('increase batch', name, case, row['cpu_seconds'])
                else:
                    row = helper.parse_sample(name, case, batch, process.stdout, process.stderr)
                    assert row['comparison_timing_sufficient'], ('increase batch', name, case, row)
                    row['status'] = 'ok'
                row.update(engine=name, round=round_, position=position,
                    phase='validation' if round_ == 0 else 'measurement', started_at_utc=started,
                    command=command, cwd=str(directory), stdout=process.stdout, stderr=process.stderr,
                    revision=revision, runtime_sha256=runtimes.get(name), **identities[name])
                out.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
                out.flush()
                print(round_, case, name, row['per_query_cpu_seconds'], flush=True)
for name, (binary, directory) in engines.items():
    assert sha(binary) == identities[name]['binary_sha256']
    if name in runtimes: assert runtime(directory) == runtimes[name]
for path, digest in sources.items(): assert sha(path) == digest
